data.text: Compose an email to a colleague asking for some help in solving this. Only frame the problem - do NOT state your own hunches as you may be hallucinating.
in 1-2 sentences, can you please re-explain that in plain English?
pressure test that proposed refactor. audit all callsites, see if it holds up

Fetch & merge main. Then, carefully consider any changes in that diff and how they might impact our code. Resolve conflicts, including any clear refactoring or simplification that might be warranted as a result of the changes. Then commit and push.

commit, push, and rewrite the PR metadata given the actual scope of the PR. inspect the actual delta vs main and use the $pr skill to write a clear, simple, human readable title + description - not a book report.

what's your "take" on this PR? is it a net improvement to codebase quality, or mostly shifting complexity? is it actually the right abstraction, or is there an even simpler design that could be unlocked with a deeper refactor?
